long_biography.plain_text:
Investor Kyle Davies helped Three Arrows Capital exploit the price premium on shares in Grayscale Bitcoin Trust. The strategy involved subscribing for shares, waiting through a six-month restriction and then selling. When the shares began trading at a discount, he became reluctant to discuss the position publicly because other traders could anticipate the firm's decisions.

Two early partners wanted to retire, and the firm bought them out without replacing them. Davies later concluded that he and Su Zhu should have persuaded them to stay or recruited several people to take over their responsibilities.
